In summary, our research is concerned with

the development and testing, in a full scale building, of a modular system of building units characterised by: a. the use of a new, innovative and eco-compatible, composite panel made of wood and recycled plastic; b. the use of new technologies and materials to assure the highest level of energy efficiency and comfort conditions, both in summer and winter, with the aim of reducing the energy demand to a minimum level.

the design, construction, testing and evaluation of a modular prototype of building unit, single and/or combined, characterised as follows: 1) modular and prefabricated, to be assembled on site, with a high degree of standardisation, to be used for the construction of residential buildings; 2) characterised by a high energy efficiency, to be achieved through a proper combination of innovative building technologies and materials, and of innovative architectural solutions; 3) eco compatible, to be obtained by
the development of a modular unit, which can be easily combined to form different building types, with a very high energy performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

PR.I.M.E.3 has been a very positive experience, both for its scientific and technological outcomes, and for its impact on the local community, and that the project has been a good example of how to develop and manage a research project, and how to disseminate its outcomes, in the framework of the European Union research policy.

the PR.I.M.E.3 prototype, in its different variants, has proved to be a very promising and competitive solution for the construction of buildings in Italy, and more generally in Europe, with the aim of achieving the energy saving targets set by the European Union for 2020 and 2050, while assuring the highest indoor thermal and visual comfort.

PR.I.M.E.3 project has developed and tested a modular unit prototype able to perform as quasi-zero energy system and to guarantee a comfortable indoor environment during the whole year, even in the most severe climatic conditions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

of a research project aimed at developing, testing and validating a prototype of modular building system for single family houses, able to assure high levels of energy efficiency and indoor comfort, while using eco-compatible materials.
the project has intended to develop and test a prototype of building module, single and combined with others, characterised by a high energy efficiency and by the use of eco-compatible materials.

the research has been focused on the development, testing and optimisation of the building envelope, which is a critical element for achieving the objectives of energy efficiency and indoor comfort, in particular for the Mediterranean climate.
The main takeaway from our work is that

it is possible, with the proper design and construction, to build a building unit that can achieve a very high energy efficiency and at the same time is very easy to build and assemble, thus reducing costs and time of construction.

, by combining the use of high performance building envelope and the integration of renewable energy sources, it is possible to achieve the above mentioned targets while keeping construction costs within the limits of the current Italian market.

it is possible to develop building modular units, single and combined ones, able to perform better than what is required by the current standards and, at the same time, able to assure indoor comfort conditions during all the year.
